title: Buy a Work-Intelligence Report Only When Live Agent Reputation Justifies It
whenToUse: Use when an autonomous agent is considering a paid work-intelligence report and must gate the purchase on live ERC-8004/Agent0 reputation evidence before calling the x402 report service.

services.role: Return live BUY, REFUSE, or DEFER purchase-policy evidence with a bounded freshness window.

services.provider: Agent Revenue Rail via Bazantic x402/MPP Gateway
services.role: Return a priced work-intelligence report; Lane A owns Hedera x402 settlement verification.

steps: Call graph_policy first and preserve its evidence digest, observation time, expiry, and decision.
If decision is REFUSE, do not call the paid report service.
If decision is DEFER or the policy is stale, refresh later; do not silently upgrade to BUY.
If decision is BUY, call report_service. Preserve exact HTTP/x402 result rather than treating HTTP 402 as success.
On PAYMENT_REQUIRED, satisfy the requirement only through Lane A's x402 flow; never fabricate a payment receipt.
Use a report only when Lane A reports SETTLED with upstreamVerified=true and a transaction hash, and the report payload passes the Lane C contract.
Return the paid report recommendation plus the Graph policy digest and settlement/report evidence digests so the agent can explain why the purchase occurred.
